page.layout: One page of running text in one wide column; marginal notes in the right margin beside the text. Head: running title and page number. Foot: signature at left, catchword at right.

main_text.p: verterat legatus, catera ad pacandam Frisiam, uti firebat[?], procuraturus. Idem vero anno sequente, nomine MAXIMILIANI regis, qui patri successerat, in Frisiam rediit, mandata secum ferens de EPHORO in Frisia, quem PO-TESTATEM dicere mos erat, designando, & simul diploma de libertate gentis. Sed & civitas Groningana, quae suos quoq; homines una cum socijs delegaverat ad eundem regem, amplissimum diploma ab eo impetravit, quo foedus OS-TERGOUM Diploma Maximiliani Capodunensi, confirmas fadusOstergoum. utraq; parte petente solenniter confirmatum fuit, praesentib. in aula, & nequicq; contra nitentibus Scringijs. Id diploma datum Campoduni die xxiii Maii: eoq; comprehensi quod illi, qui post percussum foedus primum eidem deinde accesserant. Ait litera regis Camstraeo[?] data viro nobili, in aula nato, regiq; grato, differentionem peperere: dissensio tumultus dedit: per eos iste deducta res est, ut BOLSVERDIA, VVORCVMVM, STAVERA, HINDELOPA, & maxima nobilitatis VVESTERGOÆ, maxima item plebis rustica pars foedus novum cum Gro-ninganis, foederi OSTERGOO simillimum, percusserint, deniq; paulo post tota pene VVESTERGOA excepta FRANEKERA cum coniuratis viris nobilibus, in Groningensium ac sociorum potestatem venerit: quod factum anno Christi M. CCCC. XCVI.

page.notes: Right-margin notes: "Diploma Maximiliani Capodunensi, confirmas fadusOstergoum" (printed in three lines: "Diploma / Maximiliani / Capodunen- / fe, confirmas / fadusOster- / goum."), and "Fœdus nevum cum VVeltergois, Ostergoo foederi simile" (printed "Fœdus ne- / vum cum / VVeltergois, / Oftergoo fœ- / deri simile."). Both are placed beside their lines in the margin; exact placement within the paragraph is approximate. Doubtful readings: "firebat" (possibly a long s form), "Camstraeo", and the marginal "fe" and "fadusOster-goum" fragments. The block of the page is one paragraph because no clear indentation separates the printed paragraphs.
